hooks.name: Backend: docs freshness
hooks.description: Targets entra-backend (Spring Boot). Fires when a Controller, Entity, or Repository Java file is saved (these define API surface and persistence). Reminds the agent to update the relevant DOC/*.md. PostFileSave matchers are tested against the FILE PATH.

action.prompt:
A backend Controller, Entity, or Repository under entra-backend/ was just saved. These files define the public API surface and the persistence model, so the human-readable docs may now be stale.

Check whether the change affects any of the following and, if so, propose concrete edits to keep them in sync:
- DOC/API.md: endpoint paths, HTTP verbs, request/response shapes, required roles, status codes (e.g. 401/403/400).
- DOC/DATABASE.md: tables, columns, constraints, and the Flyway-owned schema description (remember: entities must match Flyway migrations because Hibernate runs in validate mode).
- DOC/SECURITY.md: any change to authorization rules (which role can read vs write).

List exactly what changed in the code and which doc sections need updating. Do not rewrite docs wholesale; suggest minimal, accurate edits. Only apply doc edits if the user confirms.
